profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at MITRE
profile.summary: I am a software engineering and human factors professional who collaborates with MITRE thought leaders to refine abstract ideas and bring concepts to market through the development of technology forward and insightfully designed prototypes so they can test their hypotheses, engage government and industry stakeholders, and improve the safety, efficiency, and effectiveness of the domain.

positions.title: Senior Human Centered Engineer
positions.description: Design, develop and provide consultation for graphical user interfaces for web, desktop and mobile device applications. Lead human factors aviation research human-in-the-loop experiments during the design, implementation, and analysis phases. Prepare formal reports and briefings for sponsors to communicate the results of human-in-the-loop experiments. Interface directly with internal and external customers as needed during project lifecycle. Known within operating group as a go-to person for user interface and mobile application development related questions. Recognized by department management for leadership skills and abilities.

positions.title: Human Factors Engineer
positions.description: Led and co-led design and conduct of pilot and Air Traffic Controller performance testing for future aviation systems and concepts. Performed statistical analyses, authored reports, and provided project briefings to communicate results and conclusions of experiments. Assisted with various software development projects for internal applications

positions.title: Associate Human Factors Engineer & Technical Project Support Specialist
positions.description: Co-led and assisted with multiple human-in-the-loop experiments – responsible for concept development, questionnaire construction, experiment implementation, and data analysis and reduction. Assisted with coordinating department business processes such as future capital purchases. Job family and title was re-designated to Associate Human Factors Engineer in August 2007.

company.name: Lerner Enterprises & Washington Nationals Baseball Club, LLC

educations.fieldOfStudy: Strategy and Tactics for Initial Company Operations (STICO)

patents.title: Digital Copilot
patents.description: The present disclosure is directed to providing pilots with timely information to allow for better decision making and improved safety during the piloting of a flight. The systems and methods described herein can employ a collection of algorithms that can take disparate information, process it, and synthesize it into meaningful information for a pilot, flight crew, other flight systems, and/or other algorithms to consume.
